description:
We are the Dancin' Bros Team.

We like to make interactive games and software

We are a family that loves computers ad technology and is eager to participate with NASA Technology!

Our team will use Scratch at cocrea for this project

Thanks for checking us out!
summary:
This is a game where you need to collect trash and arrive to the moon, avoid the meteorites.
This is an educational game for all ages which uses the Debris API from NASA.gov to generate trash in the levels, incrementing difficulty to raise awareness.
Level one is available.
Completely coded in SNAIL IDE/Scratch
details:
This is a game where you need to collect trash and arrive to the moon, avoid the meteorites.

Level one is available.

More levels will be added with more updates.
Completely coded in Snail IDE with Nasa's Debris API

About 443 lines of code and 6 sprites.
